rest of TNR amid board fight New $850M debt deal moves Troilus copper-gold project closer to full funding A new debt-financing accord brings Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG; US-OTC: CHXMF) closer to securing the entire capital needed to develop its namesake copper-gold project in Quebec. Germany’s KfW IPEX-Bank and France’s Société Générale agreed to underwrite $850 million (C$1.2 billion) of...
